author: LadyLeigh
name: Crates
short: Configurable crate pulls and item collections.
description: Start with an empty catalog, configure weighted crate tiers and items, collect rewards, and rank server members by collected value.
install_msg: Configure tiers and items with [p]crateset before using [p]crate pull. See [p]help crateset for configuration commands.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server member IDs, inventories, pull counts, collected values, and last pull timestamps. Supports Red's user data deletion requests.
